state.unreadable: {path} cannot be read. Choose another folder or delete that file.
state.newer_format: {path} was written by a newer installer. Use that installer or another folder.
state.output_changed: Installed files of step '{step}' changed since they were made; that step runs again.
check.release_incomplete: The installer folder is incomplete; missing: {paths}. Unpack the release again.
check.dest_not_folder: The install location {path} is a file, not a folder.
check.dest_not_empty: The install folder {path} is not empty and holds no earlier installation. Choose an empty folder.
check.toolchain_broken: The bundled compiler does not work: {detail}
check.glibc_old: This system's C library is glibc {version}; the setup's compiler needs {need} or later (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 35, SteamOS 3 and newer have it). Updating the system fixes this.
check.host_probe_failed: The computer check did not run (exit code {code}).
check.cpu_no_avx2: This processor lacks AVX2 (x86-64-v3), which the game needs. Intel Haswell (2013) or AMD Excavator / Zen and newer have it.
check.vulkan_missing: No Vulkan driver is installed. Install the latest driver for your graphics card.
check.vulkan_no_device: Vulkan finds no graphics card. Install the latest driver for your graphics card.
check.vulkan_too_old: The game needs a graphics card with Vulkan 1.3; found: {devices}. Update the graphics driver.
check.inputs_needed: The game files are needed: choose the base game, the 1.1.1 or 1.2.1 or 1.4.3 update and prod.keys.
check.keys_unreadable: The keys file cannot be read. Choose a prod.keys file.
check.keys_no_header_key: The keys file has no header_key. Dump prod.keys from your console again.
check.keys_wrong: The keys cannot open the {input} file. Use the prod.keys of your console.
check.keys_too_old: The keys file is too old for the {input} file (needs key generation {generation}). Dump prod.keys from a console with newer firmware.
check.not_game_file: The {input} file is not an XCI or NSP game file.
check.ticket_personalized: The {input} file carries a personalized ticket; a common ticket is needed.
check.ticket_missing: The {input} file lacks the ticket its content needs.
check.base_not_totk: The base game file is not The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom ({detail}).
check.base_is_update: The base game file is an update. Choose the base game NSP or XCI (version 1.0.0) here and this file as the update.
check.base_combined: The base game file holds several packages (base game, update or DLC in one file). Choose a base game dump that contains only the game.
check.update_not_nsp: The update must be an NSP file.
check.update_is_base: The update file holds a base game. Choose the 1.1.1 or 1.2.1 or 1.4.3 update NSP.
check.update_not_totk: The update file is not a Tears of the Kingdom update ({detail}).
check.exefs_failed: The game code of the {input} file failed its checks; see {log}.
check.input_damaged: The {input} file is damaged or incomplete: {path} ({detail}). Copy that file again from its source, or dump it again, then run the setup again.
check.base_wrong_version: The base game is not version 1.0.0 ({modules} differ).
check.update_wrong_version: The update is version {found}; this release takes {wanted}.
check.disk_space: Not enough free space for {path}: {need_gb} GB needed, {free_gb} GB free.
extract.exefs_mismatch: The extracted game code does not match version {version} ({modules}).
extract.romfs_merge_failed: Applying the update to the game data failed: {detail}. Details: {log}
extract.romfs_mismatch: The extracted game data does not match version {version} (size {size}, checksum {sha256}...).
lift.failed: Translating the game code failed (exit code {code}). Details: {log}
compile.exe_in_use: {path} is in use. Close the game and run the installer again.
prepare.romfs_patches_failed: Writing the game data patches failed (exit code {code}). Details: {log}
prepare.shaders_failed: Preparing the shaders failed (exit code {code}). Details: {log}
cleanup.romfs_unreadable: The game data in {path} is missing or cannot be read after the install. Restart Windows, then run the installer again on the same folder: it extracts the game data again and keeps the rest.
prepare.pack_failed: Packing the shader cache failed (exit code {code}). Details: {log}
warn.lang_needs_fonts: Text in {lang} needs the Switch system fonts, which the installer does not extract; some text may not show.
warn.npdm_differs: main.npdm differs from the reference {version} dump; only the code modules are used.
warn.xbox_prompts_failed: The Xbox button prompts could not be prepared (exit code {code}); the game keeps the Switch prompts. Details: {log}
warn.shaders_skipped: The graphics driver crashed while building some shaders, so {count} were left out of the preparation. The game builds them when it first needs them, and the driver may crash there too; a driver update may fix it. Details: {log}
warn.kernel_old: Linux {version} lacks the write tracking the game relies on (6.7 or later); the game may run very slowly. Updating the system fixes this.
ui.title: TotK Setup
ui.intro: Builds a playable Tears of the Kingdom folder from your own game files. This takes a while and runs once.
ui.notice: The folder this setup builds contains the game. It is for your own use only; do not share or upload it.
ui.keys_private: The keys file is read in place. Its contents are never shown, copied or stored.
ui.pick_update: Choose the 1.1.1 or 1.2.1 or 1.4.3 update file
ui.update_mode: This folder holds an earlier installation. The setup continues or updates it; the game files are asked for only if they are needed again.
ui.need_update: Choose the 1.1.1 or 1.2.1 or 1.4.3 update file.
ui.missing_base: The base game file does not exist.
ui.missing_update: The update file does not exist.
ui.missing_keys: The keys file does not exist.
ui.done_text: Start {game_exe} from {dest}. The setup program and the game files you chose are no longer needed.
ui.cancelled_text: The finished steps are kept. Start the setup again with the same folder to continue.
ui.confirm_cancel: The setup is running. Cancel it and close the window?
ui.space_one: Free space needed on {path}: {need} GB (free: {free} GB).
ui.space_two: Free space needed on {path}: {need} GB (free: {free} GB); on {temp}: {temp_need} GB (free: {temp_free} GB).
launcher.title: TotK Setup
launcher.python_missing: The setup files are incomplete: the python folder next to TotK-Setup.exe is missing. Unpack the whole archive again and start TotK-Setup.exe from the unpacked folder.
